claim_boundaries: Homology-guided ORF reconstruction is technical sequence evidence, not direct expression evidence.
The p53-R9 functional phenotype is published, but its dependence on W23G/MDM2 escape is untested.
Cross-study retrogene ordinal names are not stable identifiers without accession and exact sequence.
No BioHub, embedding, Boltz or structural-model call was performed.
nomenclature_interpretation: The exploratory KF715866.1 168-aa reconstruction is not promoted as an independently validated historical TP53RTG12 sequence.
